doe-osti-3001951-a-cloud-tracking-data-s:
Arm researchers S. Gupta and A. Theisen of Argonne National Laboratory describe a cloud-tracking data set in DOE report DOE/SC-ARM-TR-324, dated October 2025. The data come from the ARM user facility's first mobile facility, set up near La Porte, Texas, for the TRACER field campaign. The instrument is CSAPR2, a C-band scanning precipitation radar that can change its scan pattern as storms develop.

The team ran the radar data through tobac, a software tool that finds cloud cells and follows them over time. Settings include reflectivity thresholds of 20, 30, 40, and 50 dBZ for picking out features. The report lists the scan dates covered, the tracking settings, and the file fields users receive. Storm researchers use the set to study how convective clouds grow and move.
